manuscript.recommendation_en: Major revision is required before the deployment claim can be evaluated.
manuscript.recommendation_zh: 在能够评估部署结论之前，稿件需要进行实质性大修。

issues.title_en: The image-level split does not establish sequence independence
issues.title_zh: 图像级拆分没有建立序列独立性
issues.evidence_en: Eight temporally related images from one specimen are randomly split into training and test images.
issues.evidence_zh: 来自同一试件的八张时间相关图像被随机拆分到训练集和测试集。
issues.impact_en: Near-duplicate temporal content can inflate the reported accuracy and cannot support generalization to unseen structures.
issues.impact_zh: 时间上高度相似的内容可能抬高准确率，无法支持对未见结构的泛化结论。
issues.required_action_en: Use specimen- or sequence-level holdout and report results on a genuinely independent test set.
issues.required_action_zh: 采用试件级或序列级留出，并在真正独立的测试集上报告结果。

issues.title_en: The deployment claim lacks uncertainty and repeated-run evidence
issues.title_zh: 部署结论缺少不确定性和重复运行证据
issues.evidence_en: The manuscript reports one accuracy value without confidence intervals, repeated seeds, or an external test set.
issues.evidence_zh: 稿件只报告一个准确率，没有置信区间、多随机种子或外部测试集。
issues.impact_en: The magnitude and stability of the claimed performance are unknown.
issues.impact_zh: 所声称性能的幅度和稳定性均不明确。
issues.required_action_en: Report repeated runs, uncertainty intervals, and an external or specimen-level test.
issues.required_action_zh: 报告重复运行、不确定性区间以及外部或试件级测试。

strengths_en: The manuscript states a concrete deployment-oriented objective.
strengths_zh: 稿件提出了明确的部署导向目标。
acceptance_gate_zh: 采用序列独立的数据拆分。
报告重复运行与不确定性。
